home.brandTitle: Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations
home.tagline: The community of associative leaders shaping tomorrow's social impact.
home.welcomeText: We are pleased to welcome you to the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations, a space dedicated to women and men engaged in associative management, bearers of visions, initiatives and projects with strong social impact.
home.communityText: Our community brings together association presidents, executive directors, project managers, as well as civil society actors eager to strengthen their skills, develop their networks and contribute to a more structured, professional and effective associative ecosystem in service of national development.
home.clubDescription: Within the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations, you will find a privileged place of exchange, where sharing experiences, collaboration and collective intelligence are at the heart of our actions. Whether it's strengthening your management skills, making your organization shine or creating synergies with other associations, the Club offers you a unique platform to move forward.
home.benefit1: Thematic networking events, promoting meetings between engaged associative leaders.
home.benefit2: Conferences and masterclasses led by experts in governance, resource mobilization, leadership, project management and social communication.
home.benefit3: Practical workshops to equip associations (financial management, strategy, good governance, advocacy, social innovation...).
home.benefit4: Mentoring and support opportunities, allowing to strengthen the professionalization of associative structures.
home.benefit5: Digital platform bringing together resources, articles, guides, tools and feedback to support leaders on a daily basis.
home.benefit6: Forums and discussion spaces, promoting dialogue and cooperation between actors in the associative sector.
home.communityValues: Our club is above all a caring, responsible and forward-looking community, where each member can find support, inspiration and development opportunities. We firmly believe that the strength of the associative sector lies in solidarity, civic engagement and the ability to create bridges between organizations to respond to the social challenges of our country.
home.joinText: Whether you want to expand your network, strengthen your skills, give more impact to your association or stay informed of best practices in the sector, the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations is the ideal space to support your ambition.
home.welcomeMessage: Welcome to a universe where commitment, leadership and social impact are at the heart of our action.
home.visionText: Build a national community of engaged, competent and responsible associative leaders, capable of transforming social challenges into opportunities for sustainable development, to make the Moroccan associative sector a model of excellence, governance and impact.
home.missionText: Accompany, train and connect associative leaders in order to strengthen their skills, develop their networks and contribute to a more structured, professional and effective associative ecosystem in service of national development.
home.value1Text: Promote ethical, transparent governance oriented towards the general interest.
home.value2Text: Act with conviction and put people at the center of all initiatives.
home.value3Text: Encourage sharing, mutual support and partnerships between associations.
home.value4Text: Stimulate creativity and new approaches to effectively respond to societal challenges.
home.value5Text: Develop modern, rigorous and high-performance associative practices.
home.value6Text: Guarantee a climate of trust, listening and mutual respect between members.
home.objective1Text: Through training, workshops, masterclasses, mentoring and specialized support.
home.objective2Text: By promoting good practices, governance and organizational performance.
home.objective3Title: Create a strong and active national network
home.objective3Text: To facilitate partnerships, collaborations and inter-associative synergies.
home.objective4Title: Promote social innovation and positive transformation
home.objective4Text: Encourage innovative projects and sustainable social impact.
home.objective5Title: Value the role of associative leaders
home.objective5Text: Recognize sector leaders as strategic actors of social progress.
home.objective6Title: Provide tools, resources and exchange platforms
home.objective6Text: Articles, guides, exchange groups, documentation, networking…
home.charterIntro: Each member of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations commits to:
home.charter1Text: Respect laws, good associative practices and club values.
home.charter2Text: Share experience, support other members and promote cooperation.
home.charter3Text: Attend activities, contribute to exchanges and positively represent the club.
home.charter4Text: Protect data, sensitive information or internal discussions.
home.charter5Title: Promote good governance within your association
home.charter5Text: Transparency, responsibility, efficiency and civic engagement.
home.charter6Text: Propose ideas, experiment with new practices and value initiatives.
home.charter7Title: Act in the general interest and social development of Morocco
home.charter7Text: Put leadership at the service of the community and social progress.
home.identityLegalFormText: Non-profit association offering services to the community of leaders.
home.identityWhyText: The Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations (CDDAM) was born from a real and urgent need: to accompany the transformation of the Moroccan associative sector, strengthen its leaders, and bring forth a new generation of engaged, competent and responsible leaders.
home.identityScopeText: CDDAM intervenes in a set of actions aimed at strengthening the skills, network and impact of associative leaders. Its activities cover the following areas:
home.identityScope1: Training & Capacity Building: Practical workshops, seminars, masterclasses, associative leadership programs, governance training, project management, communication, resource mobilization…
home.identityScope2: Networking & Professional Exchanges: Meetings between leaders, thematic events, discussion groups, sectoral circles, professional lunches and coffee meetings.
home.identityScope3: Support & Mentoring: Individual coaching, collective support sessions, connection with experts and partners, sharing of good practices.
home.identityScope4: Resource Production: Practical guides and tools, articles, studies, analyses, methodological notes, online documentary platform, digital library.
home.identityScope5: Innovation & Social Initiatives: Incubation of associative project ideas, support for structuring impact projects, creation of inter-associative synergies, support for innovative citizen initiatives.
home.identityScope6: Advocacy & Representation: Participation in public consultations and debates, defense of associative sector interests, contribution to improving social policies, representation with institutions and partners.
home.identityScope7: Community Animation: Regional club groups, inter-association activities, member engagement in social actions, strengthening of mutual aid and solidarity spirit.
home.identityOrientationText: CDDAM is oriented towards professionalization, cooperation and sustainable social impact. Its action is guided by a will to:
home.identityOrientation1: Strengthen associative leadership: Accompany leaders to improve their skills, strategic vision and capacity for action.
home.identityOrientation2: Promote modern and ethical governance: Encourage transparency, responsibility, good management and credibility within associations.
home.identityOrientation3: Foster inter-associative collaboration: Create bridges between organizations to facilitate partnerships, synergies and common projects.
home.identityOrientation4: Drive social innovation: Stimulate new approaches, tools and solutions to effectively respond to social needs.
home.identityOrientation5: Support territorial and citizen development: Align club actions with national and regional priorities, placing the general interest at the center.
home.identityOrientation6: Value the role of associative leaders: Recognize associative leaders as essential actors of social progress in Morocco.

about.title: About
about.subtitle: Discover who we are
about.presentationText1: The Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations (CDDAM) is a national structure dedicated to capacity building, networking, valorization and support for associative leaders, social entrepreneurs and impact project carriers.
about.presentationText2: Our mission is to create a dynamic and professional ecosystem that enables leaders of the Moroccan associative sector to develop their skills, share their experiences and create strategic partnerships to maximize their social impact.
about.globalObjectiveText: Create a structured, professional and dynamic network enabling association leaders to develop their skills, share their experiences and create partnerships.
about.legalFormText: Non-profit association offering services to the community of leaders.
about.whyText: The Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations offers a quality, secure and effective professional network, with an innovative platform and a directory of experts specialized in the associative sector. We offer tools, resources and networking opportunities exclusively dedicated to association leaders.
about.visionText: To be the essential reference in terms of development and capacity building of the Moroccan associative sector, by creating an ecosystem of excellence that promotes innovation, collaboration and sustainable social impact.

about.mission4: Promote excellence and innovation in the associative sector

activities.title: Activities
activities.perimeters: The Club of Directors – Association operates in the following perimeters:
activities.madeInMoroccoText: We support and promote "Made in Morocco" initiatives and associations. We encourage the development and promotion of local associative projects, thus contributing to the growth of the associative sector and the social development of the country.
activities.presenceText: We have an extensive presence throughout Morocco, with representations in the twelve regions of the country. We organize events and activities in different cities to facilitate the participation of our members throughout the national territory, while developing connections at the international level.
activities.sectorsText: Our community brings together leaders and professionals from various associative activity sectors. We promote sectoral diversity to enable enriching inter-associative exchanges and collaborations. Whatever the field of activity, we offer a space conducive to networking and sharing expertise.
activities.conclusion: We are proud of our commitment to supporting the Moroccan associative sector and facilitating connections between leaders at the regional, national and international levels. Our extensive presence allows us to offer partnership and collaboration opportunities in various sectors, while contributing to overall social and economic development.
activities.conclusion2: The Club of Directors – Association strives to create a dynamic ecosystem where Moroccan associations thrive and where leaders can exchange, collaborate and develop in a regional, national and international context.
activities.activitiesTitle: Activities of the Club of Directors – Association
activities.businessCirclesText: Business circles are regular meetings where members of the Club of Directors – Association, from different activity sectors, come together to strengthen their networks through business recommendations and strategic exchanges. These circles offer a platform conducive to exchanging contacts, recommendations and synergies between members, thus promoting the development of their professional network and the generation of new inter-associative collaboration opportunities.
activities.networkingText: Monthly networking evenings are key events of the Club of Directors – Association. Each month, a specific theme, related to the concerns of our members, is addressed during these evenings. They offer a unique opportunity for associative leaders to connect, exchange ideas, share their experiences and develop their professional network. Networking evenings are a real catalyst for synergies and collaborations between members of the associative sector.
activities.congressText: The Club of Directors – Association regularly organizes thematic congresses that address current topics and of interest to the community of associative leaders. These congresses offer the opportunity to deepen specific themes, explore new trends and acquire in-depth knowledge in different areas of the associative sector. Congresses are key moments of expertise sharing and networking within the Club.
activities.assembliesText: The assemblies of the Club of Directors – Association are privileged moments of governance and collective decision-making. They allow members to actively participate in the life of the Club, discuss strategic orientations, exchange on the challenges of the associative sector and contribute to the development of the community. These assemblies strengthen participatory democracy and transparency within the Club.
activities.eventsText: In addition to regular activities, the Club of Directors – Association also organizes special events throughout the year. These events can include lunch-debates, gala dinners, study trips, informal meetings, special conferences or team building activities. These special moments offer Club members unique opportunities to connect, have fun and strengthen their professional relationships in a friendly and inspiring setting.
activities.forumsText: The forums of the Club of Directors – Association are spaces for dialogue and exchange where members can debate important questions related to the associative sector, share their experiences and propose innovative solutions to social challenges. These forums promote constructive dialogue, collective intelligence and the creation of synergies to effectively respond to social development challenges in Morocco.
activities.activitiesConclusion: These varied activities of the Club of Directors – Association aim to promote the exchange of experiences, knowledge sharing, strengthening of the professional network and development of collaborations between associative leaders. They contribute to creating a dynamic and stimulating environment where members can maximize their opportunities for growth, development and success in their mission to serve society.
activities.cta: Join us and participate in our activities
activities.ctaText: Become a member of the Club of Directors – Association Morocco and benefit from privileged access to all our activities

partners.title: Partners
partners.subtitle: Strategic alliances for sustainable impact
partners.privateDescription: The private partners of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations are companies and organizations from the private sector that share our vision of a strong and professional associative sector. These strategic partnerships enable the creation of synergies between the associative world and the private sector, thus promoting social innovation, sustainable development and the creation of shared value.
partners.privateBenefit1: Access to an influential network of associative leaders
partners.privateBenefit2: Increased visibility at our events and activities
partners.privateBenefit3: Collaboration opportunities on social impact projects
partners.publicDescription: The public partners of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations include government institutions, public administrations and state organizations that recognize the importance of the associative sector in national development. These collaborations enable strengthening dialogue between the associative sector and public authorities, thus contributing to improving social policies and promoting good governance.
partners.publicBenefit3: Access to funding and support programs
partners.publicBenefit4: Collaboration on projects of general interest
partners.ngoDescription: The NGO partners of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations are non-governmental organizations working for social development, humanitarian action and the promotion of rights. These partnerships enable the creation of synergies between different civil society organizations, thus strengthening their collective impact and their capacity to respond to social challenges in Morocco.
partners.generalTitle: The commitment of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations to its partners
partners.generalSubtitle: A collaboration based on trust, transparency and shared success
partners.generalText1: The Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations (CDDAM) has positioned itself as an excellence network dedicated to capacity building and development of the Moroccan associative sector. This mission could not be accomplished without the strategic partnerships that CDDAM has developed with organizations sharing its values and vision.
partners.generalText2: These collaborations are essential to strengthen our network, carry out innovative projects and create initiatives with strong social impact. Each partnership is designed in an approach based on trust, transparency and mutual collaboration, offering an environment conducive to co-creation and resource sharing.
partners.whatWeOffer: What CDDAM offers to its partners:
partners.offer1Text: Direct access to a wide network of associative leaders and decision-makers from various sectors, enabling the creation of fruitful synergies and strengthening your presence in the Moroccan associative market.
partners.offer2Text: Thanks to the many events organized throughout the year (congresses, conferences, workshops, forums), our partners have a platform to promote their services and products to a targeted audience of engaged professionals.
partners.offer3Text: CDDAM works closely with each of its partners to design projects adapted to their specific needs, including sponsorship opportunities, event partnerships and strategic collaborations aimed at supporting sustainable development and transformation of the associative sector.
partners.offer4Text: The Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations believes in the importance of lasting relationships. Each partnership is considered a long-term alliance, where benefits are mutual and based on reciprocal trust.
partners.offer5Text: CDDAM ensures that its partners are fully integrated into the network's projects and initiatives, offering them continuous support and adapted solutions to help them achieve their strategic objectives.
partners.conclusion: In conclusion, the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations is committed to being a partner of choice, with a shared vision of success and innovation. Together, we build a solid future, based on shared values and mutual collaboration, in service of the growth and prosperity of our members and partners.
partners.ctaText: Become a partner of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations and participate in the transformation of the associative sector

assemblies.title: Assemblies
assemblies.subtitle: Participatory democracy at the heart of CDDAM governance
assemblies.governanceText1: CDDAM assemblies are privileged moments of democratic governance where each member has a voice and actively participates in the life and development of the Club. These collective decision-making bodies guarantee transparency, representativeness and the commitment of all.
assemblies.governanceText2: Through our ordinary and extraordinary general assemblies, we create a space for constructive dialogue where strategic orientations are defined, important decisions are taken collectively, and where each voice counts in building CDDAM's future.
assemblies.participatoryDemocracyText: A governance system where each member can express their opinion, propose initiatives and participate in decisions that shape CDDAM's future.
assemblies.ordinaryText: The Ordinary General Assembly is held annually and constitutes the key moment in CDDAM's life. It enables:
assemblies.ordinaryItem1: Approve activity and financial reports for the past year
assemblies.ordinaryItem2: Define strategic orientations for the coming year
assemblies.ordinaryItem3: Elect or renew members of the Executive Board
assemblies.ordinaryItem5: Decide on any item on the agenda
assemblies.extraordinaryText: The Extraordinary General Assembly can be convened at any time to deal with urgent or important questions, in particular:
assemblies.process1Text: All members are convened in writing at least 15 days before the assembly date, with the detailed agenda and all necessary documents to make informed decisions.
assemblies.process2Text: The Executive Board presents reports, projects and proposals. Each member has the opportunity to ask questions, express their opinion and propose amendments in a spirit of constructive dialogue.
assemblies.process3Text: Decisions are taken by majority vote of members present or represented. Each member has one vote, thus guaranteeing equality and democracy in the decision-making process.
assemblies.process4Text: Decisions taken are recorded in a detailed minutes, communicated to all members. Regular follow-up is ensured to guarantee the effective implementation of adopted resolutions.
assemblies.value1Text: All information is communicated clearly and in advance to enable informed participation of all members.
assemblies.value2Text: All members, regardless of their region or sector, have an equal voice in CDDAM decisions.
assemblies.value3Text: A respectful exchange space where each opinion is heard and constructive debate is encouraged.
assemblies.value4Text: Each member is encouraged to actively participate and contribute to CDDAM's development and success.
assemblies.ctaText: Your voice counts! Join us and actively participate in decisions that shape the future of the Club of Directors – Association.

mycdd.title: MY CDDAM - YOUR BUSINESS
mycdd.subtitle: SOCIAL NETWORK
mycdd.description: The exclusive platform that connects associative leaders in Morocco
mycdd.welcomeText1: Welcome to MyCDDAM, your business social network dedicated to members of the Club of Directors of Moroccan Associations. MyCDDAM is designed to facilitate exchanges, collaborations and opportunities within our dynamic community of associative leaders.
mycdd.welcomeText2: As a MyCDDAM member, you benefit from exclusive access to an innovative platform that allows you to develop your network, share your expertise and create lasting synergies with other leaders passionate about associative development.
mycdd.connectText: Expand your professional network by connecting with other associative leaders, entrepreneurs and professionals from various activity sectors. Create strong links and forge valuable relationships that can lead to fruitful collaboration opportunities and strategic partnerships for your association's development.
mycdd.shareText: Share your experiences, knowledge and ideas with the CDDAM community. Publish articles, videos or photos to showcase your expertise and inspire other members. Contribute to stimulating discussions and deepen your understanding of challenges and opportunities in the Moroccan associative world.
mycdd.collaborateText: Find associative partners, consultants or experts in your field of activity. Use advanced search features to identify profiles matching your specific needs. Establish strategic collaborations that can strengthen your association and stimulate its social impact and sustainable development.
mycdd.discoverText: Stay informed about events, conferences and professional opportunities through our integrated calendar. Explore resources and content relevant to your associative activity sector. Be aware of the latest trends and innovations shaping the associative world and social development in Morocco.
mycdd.engageText: Interact with other members through comments, likes and private messages. Participate in discussion groups specific to your interests and exchange ideas with people sharing the same passions for associative development. Contribute to making MyCDDAM a vibrant, collaborative and engaged community in creating social value.
mycdd.securityText: At MyCDDAM, the privacy and security of your data are our absolute priorities. We ensure that your personal information is protected and that only authorized persons have access to your profile and activities. Your trust is essential to us, and we are committed to maintaining the highest standards of security and data protection.
mycdd.ctaText: Enjoy all the benefits offered by our exclusive business social network. Together, we strengthen our community and stimulate the collective success of associative leaders in Morocco.

events.title: Special Events
events.subtitle: Unique moments that mark CDDAM's life
events.introText1: Beyond our regular activities, CDDAM organizes throughout the year a series of special events that enrich our members' experience and strengthen bonds within our community.
events.introText2: These exceptional events offer unique opportunities for networking, learning, celebration and personal and professional development. Each event is carefully designed to create value, inspire and connect associative leaders in varied and stimulating contexts.
events.featureText: A diverse program that combines excellence, innovation and conviviality to offer our members memorable and enriching experiences.
events.type1Text: Friendly meetings around lunch where experts share their insights on current topics. The perfect opportunity to combine networking and learning in a relaxed setting.
events.type2Text: Prestigious evenings that celebrate the successes of the associative sector, reward excellence and strengthen bonds in an elegant and festive atmosphere.
events.type3Text: Observation and exchange missions in other regions or countries to discover best practices, create international partnerships and broaden your horizons.
events.type4Text: Exceptional conferences with internationally renowned speakers who share their vision and expertise on major issues in the associative sector.
events.type5Text: Moments of conviviality in a relaxed setting to freely exchange, share experiences and strengthen friendly relationships between members.
events.type6Text: Events that celebrate excellence and innovation in the associative sector, recognizing the remarkable contributions of our members and partners.
events.type7Text: Fun and collaborative activities that strengthen cohesion, develop team spirit and create memorable memories among CDDAM members.
events.type8Text: Festive moments to celebrate important milestones of CDDAM, anniversaries of eminent members and collective successes of our community.
events.type9Text: Online events accessible from anywhere, allowing participation in training, conferences and exchanges even remotely.
events.benefitsTitle: Benefits of participating in special events
events.benefit1Text: Each event is designed to offer a memorable and enriching experience, different from our regular activities.
events.benefit2Text: A variety of formats and contexts to meet all tastes and needs, from formal to casual.
events.benefit3Text: Privileged opportunities to strengthen personal and professional relationships in varied and stimulating contexts.
events.benefit4Text: Opportunities to learn, discover new perspectives and acquire skills in various fields.
events.ctaText: Don't miss these exceptional moments that enrich your experience as a CDDAM member and strengthen your professional network.

congres.title: International Congresses
congres.subtitle: Large-scale events to shape the future of the associative sector
congres.introText1: CDDAM organizes large-scale international congresses that bring together the most influential associative leaders from Morocco and around the world. These major events constitute key moments of reflection, exchange and action for the associative sector.
congres.introText2: With more than 6 international congresses organized to date, CDDAM has established itself as an essential actor in promoting dialogue, cooperation and innovation in the associative sector. Each congress addresses crucial issues and offers a unique platform to share best practices, explore new perspectives and create lasting synergies.
congres.featureText: More than 30 countries represented, world-renowned speakers, and debates that shape the future of the associative sector on an international scale.
congres.why1Text: Listen and exchange with international experts, visionary leaders and influential personalities who share their knowledge and vision.
congres.why2Text: Explore crucial current topics: associative governance, sustainable funding, social impact, innovation, international cooperation, and much more.
congres.why3Text: Connect with associative leaders from around the world, create cross-border partnerships and expand your network internationally.
congres.why4Text: Obtain a participation certificate and benefit from professional recognition that values your commitment to associative sector development.
congres.why5Text: Participate in interactive workshops and collaborative work sessions where you can acquire concrete and immediately applicable skills.
congres.why6Text: Access exclusive documents, congress proceedings, recommendations and valuable resources for your professional development.
congres.structure1Text: A solemn ceremony with opening speeches, presentation of congress issues and welcome of international participants.
congres.structure2Text: Plenary sessions with internationally renowned speakers who share their vision and expertise on major sector issues.
congres.structure3Text: Interactive workshops in small groups allowing to deepen specific topics and exchange concrete practices.
congres.structure4Text: Moments dedicated to meeting and exchanging with other participants, creating contacts and developing partnerships.
congres.structure5Text: Adoption of common declarations and recommendations that will guide future actions of the associative sector.
congres.structure6Text: Gala dinners, receptions and convivial moments to strengthen bonds and celebrate successes of the associative sector.
congres.ctaTitle: Participate in the next international congress
congres.ctaText: Join the most influential associative leaders from around the world to shape together the future of the associative sector.

networkingEvenings.title: Networking Evenings
networkingEvenings.subtitle: Connect with the most influential leaders in Morocco
networkingEvenings.introText1: CDDAM networking evenings are essential monthly events that bring together the most dynamic associative leaders in Morocco. Each month, we create a friendly and professional space where opportunities meet and synergies are created naturally.
networkingEvenings.introText2: These exclusive evenings offer a unique platform to develop your professional network, exchange innovative ideas, share your experiences and discover new collaboration opportunities. In a relaxed and elegant atmosphere, you can meet peers passionate about associative development and leadership.
networkingEvenings.featureText: Join a community of more than 6000 associative leaders spread across 12 regions of Morocco and more than 30 countries internationally.
networkingEvenings.whyTitle: Why participate in CDDAM networking evenings?
networkingEvenings.why1Text: Connect with leaders from all activity sectors and create lasting partnerships that will propel your association to new heights.
networkingEvenings.why2Text: Each evening addresses a specific theme related to current issues in the associative sector, allowing you to acquire new perspectives and knowledge.
networkingEvenings.why3Text: Discover new collaboration, partnership and project opportunities that will contribute to your association's development and growth.
networkingEvenings.why4Text: Benefit from the experience and knowledge of seasoned leaders who willingly share their best practices and lessons learned.
networkingEvenings.why5Text: With more than 60 evenings organized each year, you have regular opportunities to strengthen your network and stay connected with the CDDAM community.
networkingEvenings.why6Text: Enjoy a refined and friendly atmosphere in prestigious venues, where excellence and professionalism are on the agenda.
networkingEvenings.format1Text: Upon arrival, enjoy a moment of conviviality around a welcome cocktail. This is the ideal opportunity to get to know other participants in a relaxed atmosphere.
networkingEvenings.format2Text: Discover CDDAM news and dive into the month's theme presented by recognized experts. Various topics are covered: innovation, governance, funding, social impact, leadership, and much more.
networkingEvenings.format3Text: Participate in enriching discussions and idea exchanges. Ask your questions, share your experiences and benefit from your peers' advice.
networkingEvenings.format4Text: Continue your exchanges around a quality dinner. This is the privileged moment to deepen your conversations, exchange business cards and plan follow-up meetings.
networkingEvenings.ctaText: Don't miss the opportunity to develop your network and participate in enriching exchanges with the most influential associative leaders in Morocco.

forums.title: Forums
forums.subtitle: Spaces for dialogue and innovation for the associative sector
forums.introTitle: Collective intelligence at the service of development
forums.introText1: CDDAM forums are privileged spaces for dialogue, collective reflection and innovation where associative leaders meet to debate major sector issues and co-build sustainable solutions.
forums.introText2: In a context where social challenges evolve rapidly, CDDAM forums offer a unique platform to share experiences, analyze trends, explore new approaches and create synergies that contribute to Morocco's social and economic development.
forums.featureText: Spaces where diversity of perspectives and idea exchange generate innovative solutions and concrete recommendations for the associative sector.
forums.type1Text: Forums focused on specific themes of the associative sector:
forums.type2Text: Spaces dedicated to exploring new approaches and solutions:
forums.type3Text: Meetings facilitating the creation of strategic partnerships:
forums.type4Text: Spaces to carry the voice of the associative sector:
forums.method1Text: Each participant is encouraged to share their experience, ideas and perspectives in a spirit of respect and mutual listening.
forums.method2Text: Debate sessions organized with experienced moderators who guide discussions and ensure quality exchanges.
forums.method3Text: Workshops in small groups allowing to deepen topics and co-build concrete and actionable solutions.
forums.method4Text: Each forum results in concrete recommendations, action plans and collective commitments for the associative sector.
forums.impactText: CDDAM forums have a concrete and measurable impact on the development of the Moroccan associative sector:
forums.impact1Text: Practical and innovative solutions emerge from each forum, contributing to solving sector challenges.
forums.impact2Text: Many strategic partnerships are born during forums, creating lasting synergies between associations.
forums.impact3Text: Forum recommendations influence public policies and institutional decisions.
forums.impact4Text: Participants acquire new skills, knowledge and perspectives that enrich their practice.
forums.ctaText: Join the dialogue and innovation spaces that shape the future of the Moroccan associative sector. Your voice and expertise count!

commissions.title: Commissions
commissions.intro: The Club of Directors – Association Morocco has several commissions that focus on specific areas of interest and expertise. These commissions bring together members who share a common interest and work together to promote specific initiatives, projects and activities in their area of expertise. Commissions can cover various topics such as innovation, sustainable development, digital transformation, associative governance, funding and many other areas essential to strengthening the Moroccan associative sector.
commissions.conclusion: Each commission can leverage these activities to strengthen its impact and contribution to the Club of Directors – Association Morocco community. Commissions work in synergy to create a dynamic and high-performance ecosystem at the service of the development of the Moroccan associative sector.
commissions.ctaText: Actively participate in a commission and contribute to the development of the Moroccan associative sector

adhesion-developpement.title: Membership & Development Commission
adhesion-developpement.description: Organize welcome events for new members to promote their integration and engagement from the start. Set up a mentoring program where current members guide and support new members.
activities: Organization of welcome events for new members
Integration and engagement of new members

formation-accompagnement.title: Training & Support Commission
formation-accompagnement.description: Offer interactive and practical training to promote concrete learning. Establish partnerships with recognized experts and trainers in various areas of the associative sector.

digital-innovation.title: Digital & Innovation Commission
digital-innovation.description: Set up an innovation lab where members can collaborate on innovative digital projects. Organize seminars and workshops on emerging technological trends for the associative sector.

financement-investissement.title: Funding & Investment Commission
financement-investissement.description: Organize information sessions on different funding sources available for associations, including grants and investments. Facilitate meetings between members seeking funding and potential investors.

com-events.title: Communication & Events Commission
com-events.description: Create a global communication strategy to promote association events and member successes. Explore innovative event formats, such as interactive discussion forums and thematic meetings.

juridique-reglementation.title: Legal & Regulation Commission
juridique-reglementation.description: Provide practical guides on relevant laws and regulations for associations, with emphasis on recent changes. Organize Q&A sessions with specialized lawyers to address member concerns.
activities: Practical guides on laws and regulations
Legal monitoring for the associative sector

fiscalite-finance.title: Taxation & Finance Commission
fiscalite-finance.description: Offer financial planning workshops to help members effectively manage their financial resources. Set up tax monitoring to inform members about tax changes impacting their associations.

arbitrage-mediation.title: Arbitration & Mediation Commission
arbitrage-mediation.description: Establish clear and transparent procedures for conflict resolution within the association. Offer mediation training for members interested in developing these skills.

partenariats.title: Partnerships Commission
partenariats.description: Identify partnership opportunities with local and international organizations to strengthen the members' network. Organize missions and meetings to explore new collaboration opportunities.
